name: Faces
description: Finds faces in your photos so they can be grouped into people. Downloads the face models when turned on. Everything runs on this computer.

enableNotice.title: Face recognition models
enableNotice.body: Faces downloads the InsightFace buffalo_l models (SCRFD-10G for finding faces and ArcFace w600k_r50 for telling them apart, about 290 MB) from InsightFace's GitHub release page. These models are licensed for non-commercial research purposes only, and they are not part of Photo Beaver. Everything runs on this computer: no photos leave it.

minFaceSize.title: Smallest face to keep (pixels in the 1024 px preview)

detectionThreshold.title: How sure the detector must be that it found a face

clusterDistance.title: How similar faces must be to group (cosine distance)

minFacesPerPerson.title: Faces needed before a new person is created
